Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line and Typhoon TINO
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 04 November 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Rizal, Laguna and Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Tarlac, Zambales and Bataan within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas, Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Calumpit, Malolos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria), Nueva Ecija(Gabaldon, Laur, Bongabon, Gapan, Palayan, General Tinio, Penaranda) and Pampanga(Candaba, San Luis, San Simon, Apalit, Santo Tomas, Minalin, Macabebe, Masantol) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
